boards.title: Your First Weekend at Sacred Heart University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure campus sequence: orient on the Quad, find shared spaces, try recreation, and check the official calendar for what is on this weekend.

cards.title: Start at the Chapel Quad landmark
cards.subtitle: First stop · Park Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Use the 80-foot bell tower as an easy orientation point, then take a quiet look at the Chapel and the lawn-facing entrance.
cards.short_summary: A central campus landmark beside the Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel sits between the main academic building and Ryan Matura Library and opens onto the Quadrangle lawn.
cards.source_title: Chapel of the Holy Spirit | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Treat it as a reflective visit; check Campus Ministry for worship or program details.

cards.title: Find the water wall across the Quad
cards.subtitle: Second stop · Ryan Matura Library exterior
cards.notes: Walk to the water wall outside the library and use the paired Chapel-and-library view to learn the layout of the Quad.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor feature linking the library and Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart identifies a water wall outside Ryan Matura Library, facing the Chapel across the Quad.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor feature; pair it with a library visit during the posted library hours.

cards.title: Choose a study spot before the week starts
cards.subtitle: Third stop · Park Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Step inside to locate collaborative space and the quiet floor, then save the library hours page for future reference.
cards.short_summary: A campus study and research hub with current hours posted online.
cards.evidence_claim: Ryan Matura Library provides research support, group study rooms, collaborative spaces and a quiet floor for focused study.
cards.access_notes: Physical-space hours vary; consult the Library Hours page linked by the University before going.

cards.title: Make the Commons your meetup point
cards.subtitle: Fourth stop · Park Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Walk its four levels and note the presentation room, bookstore, student services and dining areas so you can find them later.
cards.short_summary: A four-level campus crossroads with services, study and dining space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Linda E. McMahon Student Commons includes a presentation room, bookstore, student services and two dining areas.
cards.source_title: Linda E. McMahon Student Commons | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: A student-oriented building; dining and bookstore purchases are separate.

cards.title: Pause at Pioneer Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Fifth stop · Welcome Weekend gathering point
cards.notes: Use the pavilion as a simple outdoor rendezvous point and look for officially scheduled welcome or student-life programming nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor gathering location used in Welcome Weekend programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart's Welcome Weekend schedule lists Pioneer Pavilion as the location for Big Red Welcome activities.
cards.source_title: Welcome Weekend Schedule | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Programming changes by term; confirm current events through SHU Engage or Student Involvement.

cards.title: Pick one interest to explore on SHU Engage
cards.subtitle: Sixth stop · Any campus location
cards.notes: Search one interest, open a club page for its meeting details, and join only if the group feels like a fit for you.
cards.short_summary: The official route for finding clubs, events and meeting information.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Involvement directs students to SHU Engage to find events, learn about clubs and organizations, and RSVP.
cards.access_notes: Requires SHU credentials for full access; meeting times and eligibility are set by each organization.

cards.title: Take a first lap around the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Seventh stop · Park Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Bring your SHU ID, locate the track and workout areas, and choose a short activity that feels comfortable on your first visit.
cards.short_summary: A three-story recreation center with fitness, intramurals and club sports.
cards.evidence_claim: The Valentine Health & Recreation Center houses recreation, club sports, fitness and intramurals; full-time undergraduate access is free with a valid SHU ID.
cards.source_title: Valentine Health & Recreation Center | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Regular hours: Monday–Friday 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday 9 a.m.–8 p.m. Bring a valid SHU ID.

cards.title: Book a game at Pioneer Lanes
cards.subtitle: Eighth stop · Valentine Health & Recreation Center
cards.notes: If you want a group activity, check the reservation link and arrive early enough to choose shoes, a ball and a lane safely.
cards.short_summary: A six-lane bowling center inside the Recreation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Pioneer Lanes is a 5,000-square-foot, six-lane bowling center for open recreation, events and leagues.
cards.source_title: Valentine Health & Recreation Center | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours are 5–11 p.m. weekdays and 1–11 p.m. weekends; reserve through the University link.

cards.title: Check the Pitt Center event calendar
cards.subtitle: Ninth stop · Park Avenue Campus
cards.notes: See whether a home competition or campus event fits your weekend, then confirm the event’s entry terms before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Division I competition venue and campus-wide event space.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart describes the William Pitt Athletic & Convocation Center as a Division I competition venue and campus-wide event space.
cards.access_notes: Events and admission conditions vary; use the official athletics schedule or event listing before attending.

cards.title: End with a West Campus arena plan
cards.subtitle: Tenth stop · 3135 Easton Turnpike
cards.notes: Check the official ticket link for a hockey game or the arena schedule for another program, and confirm transportation before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A West Campus hockey and skating arena that also hosts student and community programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Martire Family Arena is on SHU's West Campus and houses the men's and women's NCAA Division I hockey programs, figure skating and club hockey.
cards.source_title: Martire Family Arena | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Game tickets are sold through the official ticket link; schedules, entry terms and transportation vary by event.
